from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485207/attempts/aebe2cf00e3243528294ba8447492ab6/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The full-length 2 stripe is the boundary; move the colored object
    # against it, then mark the far side with an 8 stripe.
    if any(all(v == 2 for v in row) for row in grid):
        axis = 0
        line = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row))
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (2, grid[0][0])]
        if not cells:
            return grid
        lo, hi = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
        if hi < line:
            shift = line - 1 - hi
            side = lo + shift - 1
        else:
            shift = line + 1 - lo
            side = hi + shift + 1
        out = [row[:] for row in grid]
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c] = grid[0][0]
        for r,c in cells: out[r+shift][c] = grid[r][c]
        if 0 <= side < h:
            out[side] = [8]*w
        return out
    if any(all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)):
        axis = 1
        line = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)))
        bg = grid[0][0]
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (2, bg)]
        if not cells:
            return grid
        lo, hi = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
        if hi < line:
            shift = line - 1 - hi
            side = lo + shift - 1
        else:
            shift = line + 1 - lo
            side = hi + shift + 1
        out = [row[:] for row in grid]
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c+shift] = grid[r][c]
        if 0 <= side < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][side] = 8
        return out
    return grid
'''
